families.broadcast: Websocket broadcast to live clients is ephemeral fan-out. No record is created or lost by a broadcast; clients re-read persisted state on reconnect.
families.message_record: Catch failures writing a chat message or a stored copy AFTER the run's outcome is already recorded elsewhere (audit event, screener.* event publish, or the inline response itself). The swallowed write is a duplicate surface, never the sole record of a failure. Residual, stated plainly in the source: a failed message write is invisible to the user — but it cannot hide a run failure, because the failure's own record is written on a separate path first.
